deadline.value: Apply by December 15 (portal opens early September).
deadline.quote: The deadline for applying to the graduate program in Chemistry is December 15

gre_general.value: The GRE is not a requirement.
gre_general.quote: At this time the GRE is not a requirement to apply to the graduate program in Chemistry.

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of fee waivers exist for international applicants; upload materials without paying and email the department by December 8.
fee_waiver.quote: There are a limited number of fee waivers available for international students. | Please email chemgaa@bu.edu no later than December 8th to request a fee waiver.

supervisor.value: Admission is by the department, not an individual professor; students often do rotations first.
supervisor.quote: admissions to chemistry PhD programs in the US are made by the department, not by the individual professor. Students often do rotations for one semester when they arrive.

funding.value: Graduate students are guaranteed up to five years of funding.
funding.quote: Graduate students are guaranteed up to 5 years of funding
